title.en: Turbo-diesel names the sections; concrete pump integral piston φ220 keeps the printed cells
title.zh: 《Turbo-diesel》只提供章节，concrete pump integral piston φ220仍用已印格子

description.en: The concrete pump integral piston φ220 note follows the outline of Turbo-diesel. A φ220 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ220 as its piston.
description.zh: concrete pump integral piston φ220这篇笔记顺着《Turbo-diesel》的大纲写。φ220 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ220 写成自己的活塞。

h1.en: How Turbo-diesel arranges a note that only repeats concrete pump integral piston φ220
h1.zh: 《Turbo-diesel》怎样安排一篇只重复concrete pump integral piston φ220的笔记

directAnswer.en: For concrete pump integral piston φ220, copy the printed fragments and ignore any urge to borrow a figure from Turbo-diesel. Turbo-diesel only lends its headings. A φ220 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ220 as its piston.
directAnswer.zh: 写concrete pump integral piston φ220时，只抄已印片段，不要从来源页《Turbo-diesel》借数字。《Turbo-diesel》只出借标题。 φ220 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ220 写成自己的活塞。

body.en: “Principle” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. The integral piston page lists φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250, sold per piece, as replacement parts rather than OEM parts of other brands. This note is only φ220. Rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane are printed on the split-piston page, not as a material for this integral row. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The split-piston page also lists φ220, with its own material row and a set as the unit. Same outer diameter does not merge the two parts. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write integral piston, φ220, and the quantity in pieces. Do not add a material the page does not print. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: “原理”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 整体活塞页列出 φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250，按个供货，并写明是替换件，不是其他品牌原厂件。本文只写 φ220。橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯印在分体活塞页上，不是这一整体活塞行的材料。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。分体活塞页也有 φ220，那边有自己的材料行，单位是套。外径相同也不会把两件配件并成一件。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明整体活塞、φ220 和个数。不要补上页面没有印的材料。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: Use “History” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. A φ220 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ220 as its piston. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 用“历史”看这一节在来源文章中的位置。采购时要抄的是已印片段，不是百科正文。 φ220 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ220 写成自己的活塞。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Characteristics”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 整体活塞 page plus this size and the quantity. Stop when the printed fragment stops. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turbo-diesel
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“特性”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明整体活塞这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turbo-diesel

question.en: Does “History” on Turbo-diesel fill a blank on the concrete pump integral piston φ220 row?
question.zh: 《Turbo-diesel》上的“历史”会填上concrete pump integral piston φ220的空白格子吗？

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
